Set it to and use it with Y, X or R to replenish {{Color TPHD|Red|3 hearts}}!|N/A|TPHD}} and {{Term/Store|Warm Milk|Warm Milk|BotW|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Warm Milk}}
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} is a recurring [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. It can be stored in [[Empty Bottle]]s and usually has two helpings. Each helping recovers up to five [[Heart]]s, with the exception of {{TP}} where it only recovers three. ==Location and Uses== ==={{OoT|-}}=== Lon Lon Milk can be obtained directly from the [[Cow]]s found inside [[Secret Grotto]]es or in [[Lon Lon Ranch]] in {{OoT}}. After playing "[[Epona's Song]]" to a Cow, it will reward [[Link]] with free Lon Lon Milk.{{Cite|Moooooooooo! What a nice song... It reminds me of the pasture... That song makes me feel so good, I can produce a lot of milk! Have some of my refreshing and nutritious milk!|Cow|OoT}} As a child, Link can also buy Lon Lon Milk from [[Talon]] for 30 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|If I give ya more free of charge, Ingo will get mad at me. So I'd better sell it to you for the normal price. Wanna buy milk for 30 Rupees?|Talon|OoT}} ==={{MM|-}}=== In {{MM}}, Link can also get free Milk from Cows, although it can also be purchased from the [[Milk Bar]] for 20 Rupees. Link can also buy a special type of Milk called [[Chateau Romani]] for 200 Rupees, which grants him unlimited [[Magic Power]] for all three days. Apparently, Chateau Romani has an inebriating effect, as evidenced by [[Gorman]], who overindulges after finding out his troupe's show is cancelled.{{Cite|Hey ...You! Milk... It's miiiilk... Can you get tipsy from something like milk?!? Hic!|Gorman|MM}} This may be one of the reasons it is considered a drink for adults.{{Cite|We're milking the cows tonight! It's "Chateau Romani." It's the first time I get to drink it! Until now, my sister always said "Wait until you're an adult."|Romani|MM}} Link must protect several containers of Milk during a sidequest involving [[Cremia]]. When her path to [[Clock Town]] is blocked, forcing her to drive through the [[Gorman Track]], Link can use his [[Hero's Bow]] or the [[Troupe Leader's Mask]] to ward off two masked bandits who attack her cargo. If Link manages to save enough Milk containers, he will be rewarded with [[Romani's Mask]]. In {{MM3D}}, Link can obtain the [[Mystery Milk]] from the [[Gorman Brothers]] to deliver to Gorman. Link cannot drink it, and it must be delivered in a certain amount of time or it will turn into [[Moldy Milk]]. Link must go back in time to dispose the Moldy Milk. ==={{TMC|-}}=== In {{TMC}}, [[Malon]] goes to [[Hyrule Town]] to sell Lon Lon Milk for 100 Rupees after Link finds the [[Spare Key]] to Talon's house. The Milk containers are carried on [[Epona]]. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, Ordon Goat Milk can be purchased in [[Sera's Sundries]] for 10 Rupees and in the [[Goron Shop]] for 20 Rupees. Link obtains his first [[Empty Bottle|Bottle]] of Ordon Goat Milk from [[Sera]] after helping her, although it is only half-full. This Ordon Goat Milk is also used to make [[Ordon Goat Cheese]]. {{clear}} ==={{ALBW|-}}=== Milk is sold in the [[Milk Bar]] in [[Kakariko Village]] for 20 Rupees in {{ALBW}}. However, after the completion of the [[Premium Milk]] side quest, the price is cut in half. Different from previous games, it only contains one helping. ==={{BotW|-}}=== Warm Milk are a kind of [[Food]] that [[Link]] can make by [[Cooking]] [[Fresh Milk]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Drinking them will heal Link's [[Life Gauge]] of some of his [[Heart]]s. Having one before sleeping will ensure a good night's rest. Link can add extra ingredients to Warm Milk, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Milk}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. By drinking them, Link will receive one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Milk}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. If drunk, they will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Milk}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. They can be drunk to completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Milk}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. When drunk, Link's Stamina Wheel will be partly refilled. * '''Hasty Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Milk}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. These drinks will provide a boost to Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Milk}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. If consumed, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Milk}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. Drinking them will grant Link a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Milk}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. When drunk, they will provide a boost to Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Milk}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. One level of [[Cold Resistance]] will be given to Link if he drinks them. * '''Tough Milk''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Milk}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Make this by heating up some milk. Drink it before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. Link's defense will be increased when he drinks them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{RTBToL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:TBToL Milk icon.png|left|50px]] In {{RTBToL}}, [[Tingle]] and friends come across [[Usotami Village]] in search of [[Kakashi]], who was captured by [[Segāre]]. Once there, they will meet [[Liar]]. After a proper meeting, she gives Tingle a list of characteristics of a specific goat-like animal he need to find from a herd. When selected, Liar will milk the animal, finally giving Tingle the Milk. The Milk is used in [[Big Liar]]'s chamber, where Tingle offers the Milk to calm the monster. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBM|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Young Link]] drinks Lon Lon Milk as his {{Ssb|taunt}} in {{SSBM}}. It also appears as a [[Trophy]]. Unlike the original bottle from {{OoT}}, the sticker is light-yellow instead of blue and the [[Cow]]'s icon is fully colored rather than being a plain white outline. It also features a new ribbon with text in the label that reads ''KENKOU ICHIBAN!'' in Hylian characters, which correlates to "Health comes first!" in Japanese. ====Trophy Information==== {{SSBTrophy|SSBM|header=yes}} {{#section:Trophies in Super Smash Bros. Melee|Milk}} |} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Young Link]] drinks Lon Lon Milk as his {{Ssb|Taunt}} in {{SSBB}}. It also appears as a [[Sticker]]. ====Sticker Information==== {{SSBSticker|header=yes}} {{#section:Sticker|Milk}} |} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{HWL}}, Lon Lon Milk appears as one of the Drink Fairy Food items, used in the [[My Fairy]] Dining Room to level up Fairy Companions. It is associated with the element of [[Element|Light]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== [[File:TWW Nintendo Gallery Carlov.png|right|thumb|150px|Lon Lon Milk Bottles in the Nintendo Gallery]] *In MM, the model of Milk is a reuse from {{OoT|-}}, and the label is written as "Lon Lon Milk" in [[Hylian Language|Hylian]]. This was fixed in {{MM3D|-}}. *In {{TWW}}, the [[Cafe Bar]] on [[Windfall Island]] serves Lon Lon Milk, as a chalkboard written in Hylian advertises it along with Deku Seed Cake and [[Zora]] Coffee; however, Link cannot purchase any. Empty Bottles of Lon Lon Milk can also be seen in the [[Nintendo Gallery]]. *At one point during the development of {{TMC|-}}, it was possible to turn Lon Lon Milk into [[Butter]].{{Cite|Your Lon Lon Milk turned into {{Color TMC|Red|butter}}! It's very fresh and delicious!|N/A|TMC}} However, this feature was later removed.{{Cite Web|quote= It's... butter. In a bottle. Unfortunately, either its functionality was removed, or it was tied to a character or event that no longer exists. |url= http://tcrf.net/The_Legend_of_Zelda:_The_Minish_Cap#Butter |title= The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap Unused Items|site= The Cutting Room Floor}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:MM3D Milk (Half) Model.png|{{Game Label|{{MM3D|-}}}}A half-full Bottle of Milk File:HWL Lon Lon Milk Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Lon Lon Milk artwork File:HWL Lon Lon Milk Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Lon Lon Milk icon File:HWDE Lon Lon Milk Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Lon Lon Milk icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Chateau Romani * Fresh Milk * Meal * Milk Bottle * Mystery Milk * Premium Milk }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Milk |items= MM, MM3D, ALBW, TotK, RTBToL }} [[de:Milch]]
